subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 5: Culture and Project (National Day)
outcomes: I can read a short text about National Day in Oman.
I can say what people do in a parade.
I can talk and write about my festival clothes.

tf.s: Faisal's favourite day is National Day.
tf.why: The text is about National Day in Oman.

tf.s: In the text, there is a parade.
tf.why: There is a parade on National Day.

tf.s: In the parade, Faisal stamps his feet.
tf.why: I walk and stamp my feet.

tf.s: In the parade, Faisal claps his hands.
In the text, the dress is black and pink.
tf.why: The dress is blue, red, green and white.

tf.s: A parade is people walking together in a celebration.
tf.why: People walk together in a parade.
National Day and Eid are festivals.

tf.s: A uniform is a kind of food.
tf.why: A uniform is special clothes people wear.

tf.s: In the text, Faisal sleeps in the parade.
tf.why: He walks, stamps his feet and claps his hands.

tf.s: We can write: My dishdasha is white.

boxes.q: What does Faisal do with his feet?
boxes.why: I walk and stamp my feet.

boxes.q: What does Faisal do with his hands?
Colours of the dress in the text:
boxes.why: My dress is blue, red, green and white.

boxes.q: Which is a body action from the text?

hunt.q: Not a colour of the dress

mcq.q: Which word means people walking together in a celebration?
Which two body actions does Faisal do?
o: stamp his feet and clap his hands
bend his knees and touch his toes
mcq.why: I walk and stamp my feet. I clap my hands.

mcq.q: Write about your clothes for Eid.
o: My dress is red and green.

mcq.q: Present your poster. Which sentence is good?
o: This is our poster. It's National Day.
mcq.why: This is our poster. It's National Day.

mcq.q: Look at the parade picture. People are in the same special clothes. What are they?
Why do people stamp and clap in the parade?
mcq.why: The parade is a happy celebration.

mcq.q: Which word is NOT a festival?
mcq.why: A uniform is clothes, not a festival.

mcq.q: Which sentence about the text is true?
o: The dress is blue, red, green and white.
The text is about a robot.
mcq.why: The text says the dress is blue, red, green and white.
